instructions this week i want you to make a low poly animal. ideally, will have more than one reference image. below is demonstration of how would approach resolving model with only profile for your assignment encourage work from multiple images instead. however, some the techniques use calculate volume and resolve topological flow may be help. there an additional video in playlist that demonstrates particles as means generating feathers on my ostrich.

learning objectives

use 2d images, imagination observations / calculations generate basic 3d form combination modeling techniques, hdris (free https://polyhaven.com/hdris), or create environment animal

title: Low poly non-photorealistic rendering
text:
in this exercise, you will practice modeling a character t-pose and rendering using an npr workflow. 
learning objectives

become familiarized with the workflow.
learn workflow

instructions

model polygonal t pose. choose theme for (ie - fantasy, sci-fi, etc.).
watch tutorials.
create greasepencil modifier, shaders, materials, freestyle lines to create manga or comic book visual style.
save 1920x1080 render as lastname-npr-character.png project folder.
save your file lastname-npr-character.blend folder.
compress folder once youâve completed tutorial rename it lastname-npr-character.zip.
upload .zip assignment dropbox.

title: Modeling random objects
text:
in this exercise, you will practice polygonal modeling fundamentals and use 3d software to build a model of three random objects. 
learning objectives

become familiarized with terminology
practice workflows
perform fundamental operations including extrude, merge, bridge, bevel.

instructions

watch the blender foundation videos get refresher on blenderâs interface.
look at learning materials an understanding theory.
create project folder. save all assets folder.
obtain randomly generated objects from website. include screenshot website your folder called yourname-objects-modeling.jpg (or .png)
if are unsure about how proceed first, do quick search see if someone has tutorial for starting object. drawing object paper, then polygons over top is also helpful plan topology.
create new file each folder.

naming: yourname-modeling-object1, yourname-modeling-object2, yourname-modeling-object2


create one scene set step 2. (you should be making since youâve created scenes.)

title: Texturing Low-poly Assets with a Palette Texture
text:
texture a set of low-poly assets with single shared color-palette texture, common technique for stylized games. learning objectives

unwrap uvs onto palette texture
use one material across many assets
keep consistent color scheme

text:
